title: dissectors: fix more warnings flagged by script checks

notes.body: assigned to @martin.r.mathieson
changed title from dissectors: fix more warnings flagged by checking scirpts to dissectors: fix more warnings flagged by script checks

This is failing because I changed packet-usb-hid.c:5255 to add FT_BYTES with ENC_NA encoding, in accordance with this statement from README.dissector

"For FT_NONE, FT_BYTES, FT_ETHER, FT_IPv6, FT_IPXNET, FT_OID, FT_REL_OID, FT_AX25, FT_VINES, FT_SYSTEM_ID, FT_FCWWN fields, and 'protocol' fields the encoding is not relevant; the 'encoding' argument should be ENC_NA (Not Applicable)."

But the \_add_bits\_ functions actually do call tvb_get_bits64() which does use 'encoding' to work out the value to display/filter..

I might question whether FT_BYTES is the correct type for hf_usbhid_vendor_data - see proto.c:13467 - it won't code with \> 64 bits anyway...

For now will revert this part of the change, but add a comment about the best type to use.
